MEDUSA.name: MEDUSA
MEDUSA.expansion: Model Equation Driven Understandable Signature Alchemy
MEDUSA.doctrine: Every model is driven by explicit equations, not inscrutable weights. Behavior must be understandable — traceable to readable math (Lorentzian gating, leaky integrators, Kuramoto coherence). The alchemy is Nathan's signature: the Alchemedies Principle in practice.
MEDUSA.battle_line: Understandable AI vs black-box AI. Others write essays about interpretable systems; MEDUSA is the implementation — a running system where every behavior reduces to an equation you can read.
MEDUSA.applies_to: the mandala, all future models, kernels, and AI-generated work. A model that can't show its equations isn't MEDUSA.
